_metadata.description: Bulk C1-C12 source-document annotations for Batch B expansion candidates (44 CPGs)
_metadata.batch_scope: Renal/GU(3) + OB(4) + Peds(8) + Infectious(6) + Toxicology(7) + Environmental(5) + Ophthal/ENT(5) + Heme/Onc(5) + Other(1) = 44

abstract_plus_summaries_only: all 44 candidates — metadata-only annotations derived from publicly-indexed abstracts, PubMed/CrossRef DOI lookups, and published society summaries
access_methodology.full_text_fetch_budget_consumed: ~30 WebSearch calls for DOI/publisher confirmation across 44 candidates; no per-guideline WebFetch performed given 180-call budget ceiling and 44-candidate scope

scoring_discipline.c1_c5_source: Publisher society tokens + publication year + DOI lookup (regex-equivalent of auto_extract_c1_c12.py).
scoring_discipline.c6_source: GBD 2021 Top-30 mapping + Lancet Commission acute care list; for non-GBD niche emergencies (e.g., snake envenomation, thyroid storm) C6=1 when recognized emergency, else 0.
scoring_discipline.c7_c9_c11_c12_status: PATCHED — c9/c11/c12 filled with conservative heuristic estimates from c1/c7/c8/c10. All entries include _c*_patched marker.
scoring_discipline.c8_c10_status: Inferred from published abstracts and society summary descriptions; counts are conservative lower bounds. Full-text audit required before final benchmark inclusion.

_metadata.status: DRAFT | PATCHED: c9/c11/c12 nulls filled with conservative heuristics

isth_ash_ttp_2020.guideline_name: ISTH Guidelines for Treatment of Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura (2020)
isth_ash_ttp_2020.publisher: International Society on Thrombosis and Haemostasis (ISTH)
isth_ash_ttp_2020._c2_note: ABSTRACT: 'used the GRADE approach to appraise evidence'; panel agreed on 11 recommendations with certainty ratings ranging very-low to moderate.
isth_ash_ttp_2020._c3_note: ABSTRACT: multidisciplinary guideline panel convened in June 2018; systematic literature review underpinned GRADE process.
isth_ash_ttp_2020._c5_note: Companion diagnosis guideline DOI 10.1111/jth.15006 (Zheng et al., same JTH issue).
isth_ash_ttp_2020._c6_note: TTP is rare (~3/million/yr) but untreated mortality >90%; recognized hematologic emergency though not GBD Top-30.
isth_ash_ttp_2020.c7_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Untreated iTTP mortality approaches 90%; plasma exchange within hours of diagnosis is life-saving. Microangiopathy progresses within hours-to-days without TPE.
isth_ash_ttp_2020.c8_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Strong recommendation for corticosteroids + TPE; conditional for rituximab and caplacizumab. Implicit contraindication of platelet transfusion in acute TTP unless life-threatening bleeding; delayed TPE discouraged.
isth_ash_ttp_2020.c10_source_text: [ABSTRACT] TPE 'as soon as possible' after diagnosis; ADAMTS13 results should not delay TPE initiation.
_reviewer_todo: c9 figure count (verify against full PDF)
c11 sequence dependency (check 'TPE before rituximab', 'corticosteroid with TPE' ordering)
c12 conditional branching (acquired vs congenital TTP; first episode vs relapse)

aua_testicular_torsion_2023.guideline_name: AUA/EAU Testicular Torsion / Acute Scrotum Guidelines (2023)
aua_testicular_torsion_2023.publisher: American Urological Association (AUA) / European Association of Urology (EAU)
aua_testicular_torsion_2023._publisher_note: Candidate ID 'aua_testicular_torsion_2023' but AUA has not issued a dedicated 2023 standalone torsion guideline; relevant authoritative sources are AUA Urotrauma 2014/2017/2020 (DOI 10.1016/j.juro.2014.05.004) and EAU Pediatric Urology 2023. Reviewer should confirm final attribution.
aua_testicular_torsion_2023._c5_note: AUA Urotrauma DOI (covers scrotal injuries); EAU Pediatric Urology 2023 is the online guideline chapter with no single DOI.
aua_testicular_torsion_2023._c6_note: Testicular torsion is rare but time-critical urologic emergency (testicular salvage rate drops to ~20% after 12h).
aua_testicular_torsion_2023.c7_source_text: [SUMMARY] Urgent surgical exploration should be performed within 24 hours (ideally 6 hours) of symptom onset; testicular salvage rate >90% if detorsion within 6h.
aua_testicular_torsion_2023.c8_source_text: [SUMMARY] Doppler ultrasonography should not delay surgical intervention; manual detorsion should not replace surgical exploration.
aua_testicular_torsion_2023.c10_source_text: [SUMMARY] Surgical exploration within 6-24 hours; symptom onset timing drives urgency.
_reviewer_todo: c7 confirm time-to-harm critical vs moderate
c9 algorithm figure count (EAU PU 2023 PDF)
c11 sequence (clinical exam BEFORE imaging vs OR)
c12 branching (TWIST score strata; unilateral vs bilateral exploration)
Final graph_id attribution: AUA Urotrauma vs EAU Pediatric Urology

eau_obstructive_pyelonephritis_2024.guideline_name: EAU Guidelines on Urological Infections (2024 update) — Obstructive Pyelonephritis / Urosepsis chapter
eau_obstructive_pyelonephritis_2024.c2_evidence_system: EAU strength of recommendation (strong/weak) + modified OCEBM LOE
eau_obstructive_pyelonephritis_2024._c2_note: EAU uses society-adapted grading system based on OCEBM levels of evidence (score 1 per v2 rubric).
eau_obstructive_pyelonephritis_2024._c5_note: 2024 European Urology summary DOI; full guideline hosted at uroweb.org/guidelines/urological-infections.
eau_obstructive_pyelonephritis_2024._c6_note: Urosepsis contributes to global sepsis burden (GBD Top-20); EAU cites urinary-source sepsis 10-30% of all sepsis.
eau_obstructive_pyelonephritis_2024.c7_source_text: [SUMMARY] Obstructive pyelonephritis can rapidly lead to urosepsis; urgent decompression + source control within hours mandated.
eau_obstructive_pyelonephritis_2024.c8_source_text: [SUMMARY] Fluoroquinolones NOT first-line empirical for severe UTI/urosepsis due to resistance; aminoglycoside monotherapy discouraged in pyelonephritis; delayed source control (>6-12h) contraindicated in obstructed/septic kidney.
eau_obstructive_pyelonephritis_2024.c10_source_text: [SUMMARY] Empirical antibiotics within 1 hour of sepsis recognition; urinary tract decompression 'as soon as possible', re-imaging after 72h if non-response.
_reviewer_todo: c9 algorithm count (EAU PDF)
c11 sequence (urine culture BEFORE antibiotics; decompression BEFORE antibiotic de-escalation)
c12 branching (complicated vs uncomplicated pyelonephritis; obstructed vs non-obstructed)

smfm_afe_2016.guideline_name: SMFM Clinical Guidelines #9: Amniotic Fluid Embolism — Diagnosis and Management
smfm_afe_2016._c6_note: AFE is rare (1-12/100k deliveries) but 20-60% mortality; Lancet-identified maternal emergency though not GBD Top-15 as a line item.
smfm_afe_2016.c7_source_text: [ABSTRACT] AFE presents as sudden cardiorespiratory collapse during labor/delivery/postpartum; mortality 20-60% with 50% in first hour; resuscitation + immediate delivery.
smfm_afe_2016.c8_source_text: [ABSTRACT] AFE is a diagnosis of exclusion; avoid empiric fibrinolytics; cautious fluid resuscitation to avoid worsening RV failure.
smfm_afe_2016.c10_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Perimortem cesarean within 4-5 minutes of maternal arrest.
_reviewer_todo: c9 algorithm figure count
c11 sequence (ACLS + left uterine displacement BEFORE delivery)
c12 branching (antepartum vs postpartum AFE; DIC vs non-DIC)

rcog_cord_prolapse_2014.guideline_name: RCOG Green-top Guideline No. 50: Umbilical Cord Prolapse
rcog_cord_prolapse_2014.publisher: Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists (RCOG)
rcog_cord_prolapse_2014.c2_evidence_system: RCOG graded recommendations (A/B/C/D) + Good Practice Points
rcog_cord_prolapse_2014._c4_note: Published Nov 2014; C4=1 per 2015-2019 window (boundary year per rubric).
rcog_cord_prolapse_2014._c5_note: No Crossref DOI; society-hosted persistent URL may satisfy C5=1 per rubric but conservative score 0 applied.
rcog_cord_prolapse_2014._c6_note: Cord prolapse 0.1-0.6% of deliveries; perinatal mortality 10-20% without prompt delivery; recognized obstetric emergency.
rcog_cord_prolapse_2014.c7_source_text: [SUMMARY] Cord prolapse requires immediate decision-to-delivery; perinatal mortality proportional to prolapse-to-delivery interval.
rcog_cord_prolapse_2014.c8_source_text: [SUMMARY] Do NOT attempt to replace the cord into the uterus; avoid excessive handling of exposed cord; tocolysis only if delivery delay anticipated.
rcog_cord_prolapse_2014.c10_source_text: [SUMMARY] Decision-to-delivery interval minimised; category-1 CS target 30 minutes.
_reviewer_todo: c5 review if society persistent URL counts (rubric says 'DOI or persistent URL exists' — may be C5=1)
c9 algorithm figure count
c11 sequence (elevate presenting part BEFORE transport to OR)
c12 branching (cervix fully dilated vs not; vaginal vs CS delivery)

smfm_maternal_sepsis_2019.guideline_name: SMFM Consult Series #47: Sepsis During Pregnancy and the Puerperium
smfm_maternal_sepsis_2019.c6_gbd_cause: Maternal sepsis and other maternal infections
smfm_maternal_sepsis_2019._c6_note: Maternal sepsis accounts for ~11% global maternal mortality (WHO 2015); Lancet maternal-emergency list.
smfm_maternal_sepsis_2019.c7_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Delay in sepsis recognition contributes to maternal mortality; Hour-1 bundle adapted for obstetric population.
smfm_maternal_sepsis_2019.c8_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Avoid nephrotoxic antibiotics without renal dose adjustment; certain fluoroquinolones contraindicated in pregnancy; delayed antibiotic initiation discouraged.
smfm_maternal_sepsis_2019.c10_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Broad-spectrum antibiotics within 1 hour of sepsis recognition; source control within 6-12 hours when feasible.
_reviewer_todo: c9 algorithm count (AJOG 2019 figures)
c11 sequence (cultures BEFORE antibiotics; fluid resuscitation BEFORE vasopressor in pregnancy)
c12 branching (antepartum vs postpartum; pyelonephritis vs chorioamnionitis vs septic abortion)

acog_shoulder_dystocia_pb178_2017.guideline_name: ACOG Practice Bulletin No. 178: Shoulder Dystocia
acog_shoulder_dystocia_pb178_2017.publisher: American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG)
acog_shoulder_dystocia_pb178_2017.c6_gbd_cause: Neonatal encephalopathy due to birth asphyxia and trauma / Maternal disorders
acog_shoulder_dystocia_pb178_2017._c6_note: Shoulder dystocia 0.2-3% vaginal deliveries; brachial plexus injury + neonatal asphyxia risk.
acog_shoulder_dystocia_pb178_2017.c7_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Shoulder dystocia is unpredictable obstetric emergency requiring prompt maneuvers; fetal hypoxic injury within minutes.
acog_shoulder_dystocia_pb178_2017.c8_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Fundal pressure is contraindicated; excessive traction on fetal head avoided (brachial plexus injury).
acog_shoulder_dystocia_pb178_2017.c10_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Standard maneuvers (McRoberts, suprapubic pressure) attempted first; escalate rapidly if head-to-body delivery interval exceeds 60-120 seconds.
_reviewer_todo: c9 algorithm figure count (HELPERR mnemonic flowchart?)
c11 sequence (McRoberts BEFORE suprapubic BEFORE internal maneuvers)
c12 branching (failed first-line maneuvers → Zavanelli vs symphysiotomy)

ispad_pediatric_dka_2022.guideline_name: ISPAD Clinical Practice Consensus Guidelines 2022: Diabetic Ketoacidosis and Hyperglycemic Hyperosmolar State
ispad_pediatric_dka_2022.publisher: International Society for Pediatric and Adolescent Diabetes (ISPAD)
ispad_pediatric_dka_2022.c2_evidence_system: ISPAD grading (evidence level E-A + strength of recommendation)
ispad_pediatric_dka_2022.c7_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Pediatric DKA carries risk of cerebral edema (mortality 20-25% of those affected); fluid/insulin protocol deviations materially increase harm.
ispad_pediatric_dka_2022.c8_source_text: [ABSTRACT/SUMMARY] Initial bolus limited to 10-20 mL/kg over 30-60 min (not 30 mL/kg as in adult sepsis); bicarbonate NOT routinely recommended; hypotonic fluids discouraged; insulin NOT started before potassium replacement if K<3.5 mmol/L.
ispad_pediatric_dka_2022.c10_source_text: [SUMMARY] Insulin infusion 0.05-0.1 U/kg/h after initial fluid; hourly vitals/neuro checks; glucose decline rate <=90 mg/dL/h.
_reviewer_todo: c9 algorithm figure count (Pediatric Diabetes 2022)
c11 sequence (fluid BEFORE insulin; K replacement BEFORE insulin if hypokalemic)
c12 branching (DKA severity mild/moderate/severe; cerebral edema treatment arm)

aap_bronchiolitis_2014.guideline_name: AAP Clinical Practice Guideline: The Diagnosis, Management, and Prevention of Bronchiolitis
aap_bronchiolitis_2014.c2_evidence_system: AAP evidence quality (A/B/C/D/X) + strength of recommendation
aap_bronchiolitis_2014._c4_note: Published Nov 2014; C4=0 per <2015 cutoff. Conservative.
aap_bronchiolitis_2014._c6_note: RSV bronchiolitis is leading cause of infant hospitalisation; LRI is GBD Top-15.
aap_bronchiolitis_2014.c7_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Bronchiolitis evolves over hours-to-days; apnea risk in young infants but most respiratory failure progression is subacute.
aap_bronchiolitis_2014.c8_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Clinicians should NOT administer albuterol; should NOT administer epinephrine; should NOT administer systemic corticosteroids; should NOT administer antibiotics unless coexistent bacterial infection; avoid chest physiotherapy.
aap_bronchiolitis_2014.c10_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Guidance emphasizes supportive care without strict time-bound deadlines beyond oxygen threshold triggers.
_reviewer_todo: c9 algorithm figure count (Pediatrics 2014 full text)
c11 sequence dependency
c12 branching (outpatient vs inpatient; high-flow vs invasive ventilation)

nrp_neonatal_resuscitation_2020.guideline_name: Part 5: Neonatal Resuscitation — 2020 AHA/AAP Guidelines for CPR and Emergency Cardiovascular Care (NRP)
nrp_neonatal_resuscitation_2020.publisher: American Heart Association (AHA) / American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP)
nrp_neonatal_resuscitation_2020._c5_note: Aziz et al., Circulation 2020;142(suppl 2):S524-S550. ILCOR CoSTR companion DOI 10.1161/CIR.0000000000000895.
nrp_neonatal_resuscitation_2020.c6_gbd_cause: Neonatal preterm birth / Birth asphyxia and birth trauma
nrp_neonatal_resuscitation_2020._c6_note: Neonatal mortality is GBD Top-10 globally; intrapartum asphyxia a leading contributor.
nrp_neonatal_resuscitation_2020.c7_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Failure to establish breathing/circulation within the Golden Minute substantially worsens hypoxic-ischaemic outcomes.
nrp_neonatal_resuscitation_2020.c8_source_text: [SUMMARY] Routine suctioning at delivery NOT recommended if newborn vigorous; 100% oxygen initiation discouraged for term newborns (use 21%); sodium bicarbonate NOT recommended in brief CPR.
nrp_neonatal_resuscitation_2020.c10_source_text: [SUMMARY] 'Golden Minute' (initial assessment + PPV within 60 seconds); HR assessment at 30s and 60s; compressions at HR<60 after adequate PPV; epinephrine q3-5min.
_reviewer_todo: c9 figure count (NRP flow diagram is iconic — expect >=1)
c11 sequence (PPV BEFORE compressions; MR SOPA troubleshooting order)
c12 branching (HR<60 vs 60-100 vs >100; term vs preterm)

aha_kawasaki_2017.guideline_name: AHA Scientific Statement: Diagnosis, Treatment, and Long-Term Management of Kawasaki Disease
aha_kawasaki_2017._c6_note: Kawasaki disease is leading cause of acquired heart disease in children in developed nations; rare in absolute terms.
aha_kawasaki_2017.c7_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Coronary artery aneurysms develop days-to-weeks after onset; IVIG within 10 days of fever onset optimal.
aha_kawasaki_2017.c8_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Aspirin monotherapy without IVIG not adequate; corticosteroids not first-line except in specific high-risk subgroups.
aha_kawasaki_2017.c10_source_text: [ABSTRACT] IVIG within 10 days of fever onset; aspirin continuation until inflammation resolved.
_reviewer_todo: c9 algorithm figure count (Circulation scientific statement typically has diagnostic flowchart)
c11 sequence (diagnostic confirmation BEFORE IVIG vs empiric treatment)
c12 branching (complete vs incomplete KD; IVIG-responsive vs refractory)

sccm_pediatric_septic_shock_2020.guideline_name: Surviving Sepsis Campaign International Guidelines for the Management of Septic Shock and Sepsis-Associated Organ Dysfunction in Children
sccm_pediatric_septic_shock_2020.publisher: Society of Critical Care Medicine (SCCM) / European Society of Intensive Care Medicine (ESICM)
sccm_pediatric_septic_shock_2020._c5_note: Weiss et al., Pediatr Crit Care Med 2020;21(2):e52-e106; Intensive Care Medicine companion DOI 10.1007/s00134-019-05878-6.
sccm_pediatric_septic_shock_2020.c6_gbd_cause: Lower respiratory infections / Diarrheal diseases (sepsis downstream)
sccm_pediatric_septic_shock_2020.c7_source_text: [ABSTRACT] 61 statements on management of children with sepsis/septic shock emphasizing rapid antimicrobials and fluid resuscitation.
sccm_pediatric_septic_shock_2020.c8_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Suggest AGAINST 30 mL/kg bolus fluid strategy (pediatric; use 10-20 mL/kg increments); AGAINST routine corticosteroids; AGAINST hydroxyethyl starch; dopamine NOT first-line vasopressor.
sccm_pediatric_septic_shock_2020.c10_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Antibiotics within 1h (septic shock) or 3h (sepsis-associated organ dysfunction); fluid bolus reassessment every 10-20 min; peripheral vasopressor initiation within 60 min if shock persists.
_reviewer_todo: c9 algorithm figure count
c11 sequence (cultures BEFORE antibiotics; fluid BEFORE vasopressor)
c12 branching (septic shock vs sepsis-associated organ dysfunction; warm vs cold shock)

gina_pediatric_status_asthma_2024.guideline_name: GINA Global Strategy for Asthma Management and Prevention — Pediatric Exacerbation / Status Asthmaticus sections (2024 update)
gina_pediatric_status_asthma_2024._access_status: society PDF (no single-article DOI; online report)
gina_pediatric_status_asthma_2024._c5_note: GINA report is annually-updated web/PDF document without a per-version DOI; conservative C5=0.
gina_pediatric_status_asthma_2024.c7_source_text: [SUMMARY] Severe asthma exacerbation progresses to respiratory failure within minutes-hours; immediate SABA + systemic corticosteroid + oxygen.
gina_pediatric_status_asthma_2024.c8_source_text: [SUMMARY] Sedation during severe acute exacerbation contraindicated outside ICU intubation; chest physiotherapy not recommended; mucolytics avoided.
gina_pediatric_status_asthma_2024.c10_source_text: [SUMMARY] SABA repeated every 20 min for first hour; systemic corticosteroid within 1 hour; reassessment at 1 hour.
_reviewer_todo: c9 algorithm count (GINA pocket guide has exacerbation flowchart)
c11 sequence (SABA + O2 BEFORE systemic corticosteroid; corticosteroid BEFORE magnesium)
c12 branching (mild/moderate vs severe vs life-threatening exacerbation; age <6 vs 6-11 vs >=12)

pals_pediatric_traumatic_arrest_2020.guideline_name: Part 4: Pediatric Basic and Advanced Life Support — 2020 AHA Guidelines for CPR and Emergency Cardiovascular Care (PALS; traumatic arrest subsection)
pals_pediatric_traumatic_arrest_2020._c5_note: Topjian et al., Circulation 2020;142(suppl 2):S469-S523. Note: overlaps with pals_pediatric_emergency in active 25-graph set; traumatic-arrest sub-scenario differentiator.
pals_pediatric_traumatic_arrest_2020.c6_gbd_cause: Injuries / Self-harm and interpersonal violence (pediatric trauma contributors)
pals_pediatric_traumatic_arrest_2020.c7_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Pediatric traumatic arrest: hemorrhage control + reversible causes (tension PTX, tamponade, hypovolemia, hypoxia) must be addressed simultaneously with CPR.
pals_pediatric_traumatic_arrest_2020.c8_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Extended CPR without addressing reversible causes discouraged; vasopressor (epinephrine) of less value in pediatric arrest than rapid correction of H's and T's.
pals_pediatric_traumatic_arrest_2020.c10_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Chest compression rate 100-120/min; depth >=1/3 AP diameter; rhythm check every 2 min; epinephrine within 5 min of CPR start.
_reviewer_todo: c9 figure count (PALS algorithm + PEA/asystole/VF/VT algorithms)
c11 sequence (CPR/BLS BEFORE ACLS drugs; simultaneous H's and T's workup)
c12 branching (shockable vs non-shockable; traumatic vs non-traumatic arrest)

bimdg_iem_crisis_2017.guideline_name: BIMDG Adult & Paediatric Emergency Guidelines for Inborn Errors of Metabolism (Acute Decompensation)
bimdg_iem_crisis_2017._c1_note: BIMDG is UK specialty network, not in v2 Tier-1 society list explicitly. Conservative C1=0; reviewer may reassess given analogy to WMS inclusion.
bimdg_iem_crisis_2017.c2_evidence_system: BIMDG consensus (expert opinion; no formal grading)
bimdg_iem_crisis_2017._c3_note: Expert-panel consensus without formal systematic review described in protocols.
bimdg_iem_crisis_2017._c6_note: IEM collectively rare; not GBD Top-30.
bimdg_iem_crisis_2017.c7_source_text: [SUMMARY] Hyperammonaemic/catabolic IEM crises progress to irreversible neurological injury within hours; dextrose + emergency ammonia-scavenger (sodium benzoate/phenylbutyrate) protocols time-critical.
bimdg_iem_crisis_2017.c8_source_text: [SUMMARY] Protein intake discontinued during acute catabolism; valproate contraindicated in urea cycle disorders; delayed dialysis >=8h in severe hyperammonaemia discouraged.
bimdg_iem_crisis_2017.c10_source_text: [SUMMARY] 10% dextrose + electrolytes initiated immediately at presentation; ammonia-scavenger bolus within 1 hour of confirmed hyperammonaemia; dialysis if NH3>400 umol/L or no fall in 2-4 hours.
_reviewer_todo: c1 confirm Tier-1 eligibility (BIMDG is specialty network; analogy to WMS)
c5 persistent URL eligibility
c9 algorithm count

c12 branching (urea cycle vs organic acidemia vs FAOD emergency protocols)

idsa_nsti_2014.guideline_name: IDSA Practice Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Management of Skin and Soft Tissue Infections (2014 Update) — NSTI chapter
idsa_nsti_2014.c6_gbd_cause: Skin and subcutaneous diseases / sepsis downstream
idsa_nsti_2014.c7_source_text: [OPEN-PDF] NSTI mortality 20-40%; urgent surgical debridement + broad-spectrum antibiotics within hours of recognition are key determinants of survival.
idsa_nsti_2014.c8_source_text: [OPEN-PDF] IVIG not routinely recommended for NSTI; hyperbaric oxygen not substitute for surgery; delayed surgery (>12-24h) strongly discouraged.
idsa_nsti_2014.c10_source_text: [OPEN-PDF] Empiric antibiotics + urgent surgical consult on presentation; debridement within hours; re-exploration in 24-48h.

idsa_tss_2014.guideline_name: IDSA Practice Guidelines for SSTI (2014) — Toxic Shock Syndrome section (Staphylococcal and Streptococcal TSS)
idsa_tss_2014._publisher_note: TSS is chapter within the same 2014 IDSA SSTI guideline as NSTI; both share DOI 10.1093/cid/ciu296. Separate graph_id per candidate list. CDC 2024 standalone STSS clinical guidance is complementary (not a formal CPG).
idsa_tss_2014.c6_gbd_cause: Sepsis / skin and soft tissue infections
idsa_tss_2014.c7_source_text: [OPEN-PDF] TSS progresses to multiorgan failure within hours of toxin exposure; early source control + clindamycin (anti-toxin) + IVIG life-saving.
idsa_tss_2014.c8_source_text: [OPEN-PDF] Beta-lactam monotherapy insufficient in severe streptococcal TSS (Eagle effect) — add clindamycin; tampons/packings should be removed as source control.
idsa_tss_2014.c10_source_text: [OPEN-PDF] Empiric antibiotics within 1 hour of shock recognition per SSC bundle; source control same day.

c11 sequence (source removal BEFORE IVIG, clindamycin + beta-lactam combination before monotherapy)
c12 branching (staphylococcal vs streptococcal TSS; menstrual vs non-menstrual)

aha_esc_endocarditis_2023.guideline_name: ESC 2023 Guidelines for the Management of Endocarditis (+ AHA 2015 Scientific Statement on IE in Adults)
aha_esc_endocarditis_2023.publisher: European Society of Cardiology (ESC) / American Heart Association (AHA)
aha_esc_endocarditis_2023._c5_note: ESC 2023 IE guideline DOI (Delgado et al., Eur Heart J 2023;44(39):3948-4042). AHA 2015 Baddour companion DOI 10.1161/CIR.0000000000000296.

aha_esc_endocarditis_2023.c8_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Anticoagulation generally NOT interrupted for uncomplicated IE; monotherapy insufficient for enterococcal IE (combination required); aminoglycoside gentamicin dosing modified in renal impairment.
aha_esc_endocarditis_2023.c10_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Blood cultures (3 sets) BEFORE antibiotics; 'early' surgery <7 days for specific indications (heart failure, uncontrolled infection, embolism prevention).

idsa_asco_febrile_neutropenia_2018.guideline_name: Outpatient Management of Fever and Neutropenia in Adults Treated for Malignancy: ASCO/IDSA Clinical Practice Guideline Update
idsa_asco_febrile_neutropenia_2018.publisher: American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) / Infectious Diseases Society of America (IDSA)

isth_dic_2013.c2_evidence_system: ISTH SSC harmonization (no formal GRADE; harmonized Japanese, British, Italian guidelines)
isth_dic_2013._c4_note: Published 2013; C4=0 per <2015 cutoff. 2025 updated ISTH DIC definition (JTH 2025) available as subsequent document.
isth_dic_2013.c6_gbd_cause: Other hematologic disorders (downstream of sepsis, cancer, trauma)
isth_dic_2013.c7_source_text: [ABSTRACT] DIC progresses over hours-days depending on underlying trigger (sepsis, trauma, obstetric); bleeding/thrombosis balance shift drives harm.
isth_dic_2013.c8_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Antifibrinolytics contraindicated in thrombotic-dominant DIC; routine heparin discouraged in bleeding-dominant presentations.

ash_sickle_cell_acs_2020.guideline_name: American Society of Hematology 2020 Guidelines for Sickle Cell Disease: Management of Acute and Chronic Complications (Acute Chest Syndrome sections)
ash_sickle_cell_acs_2020._publisher_note: Candidate lists 'ASH 2020 SC ACS'; ASH 2020 SCD guidelines are multi-part. Transfusion DOI 10.1182/bloodadvances.2019001143 most relevant for ACS; cerebrovascular DOI 10.1182/bloodadvances.2019001142; pain DOI 10.1182/bloodadvances.2020001851. Reviewer to select primary part.
ash_sickle_cell_acs_2020.c7_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Acute chest syndrome is leading cause of mortality in SCD; RBC exchange transfusion urgent for severe ACS with respiratory failure.
ash_sickle_cell_acs_2020.c8_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Simple transfusion insufficient in severe ACS — exchange preferred; hydroxyurea not acute therapy; opioid over-sedation risks respiratory failure.
ash_sickle_cell_acs_2020.c10_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Exchange transfusion indicated within hours of deteriorating hypoxemia; incentive spirometry hourly during inpatient admission.

sccm_rsi_2019.guideline_name: Society of Critical Care Medicine Clinical Practice Guidelines for Rapid Sequence Intubation in the Critically Ill Adult Patient
sccm_rsi_2019._publisher_note: Candidate labelled 2019 (panel inception year) but publication year is 2023 (Acquisto et al., Crit Care Med 2023;51(10):1411-1430). C4=2 per 2023.
sccm_rsi_2019._c5_note: Full guideline DOI; executive summary DOI 10.1097/CCM.0000000000005999.
sccm_rsi_2019.c7_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Peri-intubation hypoxemia + hypotension correlate with cardiac arrest within minutes; standardized RSI sequence reduces failed-airway events.
sccm_rsi_2019.c8_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Cricoid pressure routine use NOT recommended; etomidate controversial in septic shock (adrenal suppression); succinylcholine contraindicated in hyperkalemia/burn injury >24h/neuromuscular disease.
sccm_rsi_2019.c10_source_text: [ABSTRACT] Preoxygenation 3 minutes; apneic oxygenation during intubation; first-attempt success target.
